subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should this issue split Feishu outbound hook parity from normal-channel `inbound_claim`, and should the outbound parity repair land through the shared dispatcher contract or a Feishu-local wrapper?
rationale: The source-reproducible outbound bypass is a bug, but the full issue also asks for broader `inbound_claim` semantics and overlaps with open canonical dispatcher PRs, so automation should not choose the permanent hook ownership contract.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Fix Feishu outbound hook coverage through the maintainer-selected exactly-once outbound path and move normal-channel `inbound_claim` to a separate security/API tracker.

options.title: Fold into the canonical dispatcher PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92374 and its open PRs as the outbound fix path, while preserving this issue's Feishu acceptance criteria in that review.

options.title: Design one broad hook contract
options.body: Solve Feishu outbound parity, durable-send semantics, and normal-channel `inbound_claim` together in a larger plugin-hook design PR with higher review cost.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu outbound hook coverage through the maintainer-selected exactly-once outbound path and move normal-channel `inbound_claim` to a separate security/API tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest current-main blame and recent hook-semantics history across the implicated core and Feishu paths, while the final decision still needs input from Feishu and inbound-claim owners.
